description: This file defines the 'User' struct and related methods, constants, and types for managing user data in the Mattermost server, including validation, serialization, and user property management.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the Mattermost system, including personal info, roles, preferences, and status.

classes.name: UserMap
classes.description: A map from user IDs to User objects for quick serialization and lookup.

classes.name: UserUpdate
classes.description: Tracks old and new User objects for updates.

classes.name: UserPatch
classes.description: Used for partial updates to User objects.

classes.name: UserAuth
classes.description: Contains authentication data for a user.

classes.name: UserForIndexing
classes.description: Simplified user info for indexing purposes.

classes.name: ViewUsersRestrictions
classes.description: Restrictions on viewing users based on teams and channels.

classes.name: GetUsersNotInChannelOptions
classes.description: Options for fetching users not in a specific channel.

classes.name: UserSlice
classes.description: Slice of User pointers with utility methods.

classes.name: UserWithGroups
classes.description: Extends User with group membership info.

classes.name: UsersWithGroupsAndCount
classes.description: Collection of users with group info and total count.

classes.name: UserPostStats
classes.description: Statistics related to user posts and activity.

classes.name: LoginTypeResponse
classes.description: Response structure indicating login method details.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of user fields for auditing.

methods.name: LogClone
methods.description: Returns a clone of user data for logging.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the user object for correctness.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares user data before saving, including ID, timestamps, and password hashing.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Prepares user data before updating in the database.

methods.name: SetDefaultNotifications
methods.description: Sets default notification preferences for a user.

methods.name: UpdateMentionKeysFromUsername
methods.description: Updates mention keys when username changes.

methods.name: GetMentionKeys
methods.description: Retrieves mention keys from notify props.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to update user fields.

methods.name: Etag
methods.description: Generates an ETag for caching purposes.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Removes private data from user object based on options.

methods.name: SanitizeInput
methods.description: Sanitizes input data, removing sensitive info.

methods.name: SetCustomStatus
methods.description: Sets a custom status for the user.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Determines display name based on format.

methods.name: GetDisplayName
methods.description: Returns display name based on format.

methods.name: IsGuest
methods.description: Checks if user is a guest.

methods.name: IsMagicLinkEnabled
methods.description: Checks if magic link login is enabled.

methods.name: IsSystemAdmin
methods.description: Checks if user is a system admin.

methods.name: IsInRole
methods.description: Checks if user has a specific role.

methods.name: IsRemote
methods.description: Checks if user belongs to remote cluster.

methods.name: SetField
methods.description: Sets a specific field in UserPatch.
